description.en: A renderer-agnostic glass-material layer on wgpu: SDF refraction, chromatic dispersion and Fresnel edge glow in a single fragment pass. Any app can give any region an Apple Liquid-Glass-grade material.
description.zh: 基于 wgpu 的渲染器无关玻璃材质层：SDF 折射、色散与 Fresnel 边缘高光在一次片元着色中完成。任何应用的任意区域都能获得 Apple Liquid Glass 级材质。

tagline.zh: 不需要 Linux 经验的生物信息学工作台。

description.en: A local, cross-platform workbench that hides environment complexity behind a GUI and container isolation — visual pipelines, reproducible runs, your data never leaves the machine.
description.zh: 本地跨平台工作台：用图形界面与容器隔离隐藏环境复杂性——可视化流程、可复现运行，数据始终留在本机。

description.en: The plugin registry behind Biocraft-Spark. Every plugin is reviewed before it enters, and the Beautiful Creatures selection marks the curated few. Built as a static catalog on Cloudflare Pages.
description.zh: Biocraft-Spark 的插件注册中心：每个插件都先审后上架，「Beautiful Creatures」精选名单标出最值得信赖的一批。整个目录以静态站点形式托管在 Cloudflare Pages。

description.en: Our channel on Bilibili and YouTube — a physics-major's take on the 3Blue1Brown format: real derivations, honest rigor, and visuals generated from the actual equations.
description.zh: 我们在 B站 与 YouTube 的频道——「物理专业版的 3Blue1Brown」：真正的推导、不缩水的严谨，画面直接由方程生成。
